## Behavior
`verifyGitReference` now admits an exact 40-hex Git reference when that commit resolves in the declared canonical repository, including side-branch commits that are not ancestors of current `HEAD`. Exact repository/commit/path/tree-entry/blob OID/SHA-256/worktree/identity checks remain enforced. Reserved generated IDs/paths and foreign/unresolvable commits still fail.

## Root cause removed
Deleted only the `git merge-base --is-ancestor <commit> HEAD` gate and its `not reachable from HEAD` error from `src/recorder/admit.ts::verifyGitReference`. Retained exact `rev-parse --verify <40hex>^{commit}` resolution and every subsequent tree/blob/hash/worktree/identity check. Regenerated `dist/recorder/admit.js`.

## Regression
In `test/recorder-admission.test.ts`:
- Removed orphan and future/side non-HEAD rejection matrix cells (orphan is no longer a lawful negative after ancestry removal).
- Added positive end-to-end side-branch admit using the existing side-branch fixture: exit 0, spawn +1, promoted docket, exact authority commit/path/blobOid/sha256 recorded, HEAD and index/worktree status unchanged.
- Left malformed/short/all-zero/foreign/path/blob/hash/dirty/deleted/untracked/reserved-generated counterexamples unchanged.
